title: Attenuation of LPS-induced inflammatory responses in J774A.1 macrophages by phenylpropanoids and ursane triterpenes from Lavandula coronopifolia Poir.
task: Identify anti-inflammatory compounds from Lavandula coronopifolia against LPS-stimulated macrophages
key_results: Compounds 2, 3, and 6 downregulated iNOS and IL-6 expression, reduced cell migration, and altered macrophage morphology similar to dexamethasone; compound 5 showed selective cytotoxicity to A549 cells (EC50 11.5 µM)
comments: Natural product screening yielded promising leads but lacks mechanistic elucidation of signaling pathway inhibition and in vivo validation

model_io.model: A549 lung carcinoma cells + HEK293T normal cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: Phenylpropanoids and ursane triterpenes suppress LPS-induced inflammatory mediator expression
hypotheses.result: Confirmed for compounds 2, 3, 6; significant iNOS and IL-6 downregulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Compound 5 selectively targets cancer cells without harming normal cells
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; EC50 11.5 µM in A549, no toxicity in HEK293T

title: Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation is associated with improved functional recovery and time-dependent changes in apoptosis-related execution-phase markers after spinal cord injury
task: Determine whether rTMS reduces apoptosis and improves motor recovery after spinal cord injury
key_results: rTMS reduced apoptosis-related execution-phase signaling (caspase-3/7, PARP1 cleavage) in a time-dependent manner with improved tissue preservation and motor recovery (BBB scores)
comments: Time-dependent effects suggest rTMS efficacy requires optimal intervention window post-SCI; neuronal localization of cleaved caspase-3 strengthens mechanistic clarity

hypotheses.hypothesis: rTMS attenuates apoptosis-related execution-phase signaling after SCI
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; time-dependent reduction in caspase-3/7/PARP1 cleavage at later post-injury timepoints

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reduced apoptosis correlates with improved tissue preservation and motor recovery
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; decreased apoptotic cell death and improved BBB scores with rTMS treatment

title: Engineered Ti₃C₂ MXene nanosystems for macrophage-targeted therapy of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis
task: Target hepatic macrophages to suppress inflammation and ROS in MASH
key_results: MMCT reduced ROS, enhanced SOD activity, shifted M1 macrophages to M2 phenotype, and mitigated lobular inflammation and steatosis in murine MASH model
comments: Dual-function nanozyme approach is elegant, though translation to human MASH requires validation of mannose receptor targeting efficiency and long-term safety

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mannose-targeted MMCT selectively enters macrophages and suppresses TLR4/NF-κB signaling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; MMCT inhibited TLR4/NF-κB pathway and promoted M1-to-M2 repolarization

hypotheses.hypothesis: ROS scavenging and increased SOD activity reduce hepatic inflammation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; reduced lobular inflammation and macrovesicular steatosis in MASH mice

title: Serum proteomic signatures and an immune-calcium signaling cascade associated with antipsychotic-related erectile dysfunction in schizophrenia
task: Identify serum proteomic signatures associated with antipsychotic-related erectile dysfunction in schizophrenia
key_results: 473 differentially expressed proteins identified between APRED and non-APRED groups; RYR3, PRKCA, and KRT18 identified as hub proteins linking calcium signaling and immune pathways
comments: Interesting mechanistic insight into a neglected side effect, though causality between proteomic changes and erectile dysfunction remains unclear and would benefit from functional validation.

model_io.model: Label-free quantitative proteomics with PPI network analysis
inputs: serum samples from 66 male schizophrenia patients on risperidone monotherapy (APRED vs non-APRED stratified by nocturnal penile tumescence monitoring)
outputs: pathway enrichment annotations (immune, calcium signaling, extracellular matrix)

hypotheses.hypothesis: APRED represents a biological vulnerability characterized by immune-calcium signaling disruption rather than a simple pharmacological side effect
hypotheses.result: Pathway enrichment confirmed immune/inflammatory responses and calcium signaling disruption; RYR3 identified as central regulatory node

hypotheses.hypothesis: Distinct serum proteomic signature separates APRED from non-APRED patients
hypotheses.result: Principal component analysis demonstrated clear group separation with 473 DEPs

title: Federated multi-cloud task scheduling with load balancing using multi-objective NSGA-II and reinforcement learning
task: Multi-objective task scheduling in federated multi-cloud environments
key_results: Reduces makespan by 18–32%, improves resource utilization by 10–22%
comments: Hybrid NSGA-II and Q-learning approach is sound, though real-world federated validation across multiple cloud providers would strengthen claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tight integration of NSGA-II with Q-learning enables adaptive scheduling across heterogeneous clouds
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by simulation results; significantly outperforms baselines

title: Geometry-aware localization evaluation of grad-CAM for wafer map defect classification
task: Evaluate Grad-CAM localization accuracy for wafer defect classification
key_results: Radial suppression improves Top-10% IoU by 19.4% (0.129 to 0.155, p≪0.001); oracle upper bound 0.278
comments: Rigorous geometric bias analysis, but practical impact on industrial defect detection workflows remains unclear.

model_io.model: Grad-CAM and XGrad-CAM with radial suppression

hypotheses.hypothesis: Radial attribution bias reflects learned model representations, not gradient artifacts
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via consistent bias across Grad-CAM and XGrad-CAM; suppression improves IoU

hypotheses.hypothesis: Geometric representation characteristics contribute substantially to residual errors
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; oracle refinement establishes 0.278 IoU upper bound

title: Optimized routing with Ant Colony Algorithms to extend network lifetime in Wireless Sensor Networks
task: Energy-efficient routing in wireless sensor networks
key_results: Saves energy by 18–25%, improves packet delivery ratio by 6–10%
comments: Ant Colony Optimization with dual energy metrics is practical, though simulation-only evaluation limits assessment of real hardware variability.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Two energy metrics and spatial awareness improve load balancing vs. traditional ACA
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; outperforms ACLR, ACA, and EAACA in NS-2 simulations

title: Robust graph-transformer soft sensor for radar level estimation in dynamic LPG storage systems
task: Graph transformer soft sensor for LPG storage level estimation
key_results: R² = 0.9704, MAE = 151.12 mm, RMSE = 198.33 mm; outperforms existing models
comments: Graph attention + Transformer fusion is principled for spatiotemporal dynamics, though generalization to other liquid-level systems not addressed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Graph attention + Transformer effectively model spatiotemporal dependencies in dynamic LPG storage
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves high R², low MAE/RMSE outperforming baselines

title: A hierarchical neuromorphic multi agent framework for energy aware and secure 6G resource optimization using Neuro6G agent
task: Hierarchical neuromorphic framework for 6G resource optimization
key_results: 34.7% energy reduction, 28.3% latency reduction, 95.6% security threat detection (p<0.01)
comments: Neuromorphic SNNs with multi-agent RL is novel, but evaluation on three disparate benchmarks (channel modeling, gesture, intrusion) limits cohesion.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Event-driven SNNs with trust-aware multi-agent collaboration achieve energy-efficient, low-latency, secure 6G resource management
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 34.7% energy and 28.3% latency reduction with 95.6% security accuracy (p<0.01)

title: Improved Pied Kingfisher Optimization Algorithm for optimal scheduling of microgrids with hybrid energy storage
task: Optimal scheduling of microgrids with hybrid energy storage
key_results: Reduces mean daily operating cost by 4–10% with lower solution dispersion vs. representative metaheuristics
comments: IPKO enhancements (Chebyshev-chaotic init, multi-source guidance, spiral development) are well-motivated, but sensitivity to hybrid storage ratios not explored.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Four enhancement strategies (Chebyshev init, multi-source guidance, spiral development, dynamic adjustment) improve convergence for nonconvex microgrid scheduling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; IPKO achieves 4–10% lower cost with reduced dispersion across multiple runs

title: A federated blockchain framework for secure and intelligent smart farming in sustainable industrial agriculture
task: Federated blockchain framework for privacy-preserving smart farming
key_results: Model accuracy 92.4%, throughput 2350 TPS, block latency 1.0s; privacy leakage and energy cost reduced by 73% and 45%
comments: Hybrid PBFT-PoA consensus is practical, though scalability beyond farm-scale deployments and long-term privacy resilience need validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Federated learning + hybrid blockchain enables accurate, privacy-aware agricultural collaboration
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves 92.4% accuracy with 73% privacy leakage reduction

title: A flow field reconstruction based on cylindrical wake flow data using the PSO-CNN-LSTM algorithm
task: Spatiotemporal reconstruction of cylindrical wake flow using PSO-CNN-LSTM
key_results: Streamwise velocity error ~10⁻³, cross-stream velocity error ~10⁻², outperforms LSTM/RNN/Transformer baselines in rolling prediction
comments: Well-designed architecture with uncertainty quantification via MC dropout, though computational cost comparison to FEM not quantified.

hypotheses.hypothesis: PSO hyperparameter optimization improves reconstruction accuracy over manual tuning
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves low errors and better stability than baselines in rolling prediction

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cross-stream velocity is more sensitive to vortex-shedding phase than streamwise component
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; cross-stream error ~10× higher due to phase dependence

title: Biologically inspired optimization of construction sector eco industrial park networks using food web metrics
task: Optimize construction eco-industrial park networks using food-web structural metrics
key_results: Genetic algorithm identifies scenario-dependent configurations; connectance constrains extreme connectivity; reciprocal participation rules improve benchmark consistency
comments: Thorough biomimetic exploration, but trade-offs across metrics and construction feasibility constraints suggest no universal optimization—practical guidance for practitioners is limited.

model_io.model: Scenario-constrained genetic algorithm with multi-metric objective functions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Construction EIP networks can approximate food-web structural patterns via genetic optimization
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; structural proximity is configuration-dependent with persistent trade-offs

hypotheses.hypothesis: Connectance acts as a structuring constraint limiting extreme connectivity regimes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; explicit connectance targeting yields more balanced metric profiles

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reciprocal participation rules improve benchmark-consistent solutions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed for certain objective function and connectance combinations, not universally

title: Flashover prediction of polluted composite insulators based on arc time constant and velocity using CNN–LSTM
task: Flashover prediction for polluted composite insulators using CNN-LSTM
key_results: Superior predictive performance and computational efficiency vs. benchmarks; enables fail-safe flashover forecasting
comments: Physics-informed arc model coupling transient dynamics is elegant, but quantitative error metrics and comparison baseline details are sparse.

model_io.model: CNN-LSTM with unified arc model (arc time constant + arc velocity)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamic coupling of arc time constant and velocity captures transient flashover dynamics better than static models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; CNN-LSTM achieves superior predictions with physics-based arc velocity parameter

title: Enabling geometry and toolpath generalization for machine learning based thermal modeling in laser powder bed fusion
task: Geometry-generalizable thermal surrogate model for laser powder bed fusion
key_results: ~1000× speedup vs. finite element analysis while maintaining high accuracy
comments: Clever use of signed distance fields and time gradient fields enables geometry transfer; real-time applicability to process planning is valuable.

model_io.model: U-Net CNN with signed distance fields, time fields, and time gradient encoding

hypotheses.hypothesis: Feature engineering with distance/time/gradient fields enables single-model generalization across geometries and toolpaths
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 1000× speedup vs. FEM with maintained accuracy

title: Wideband monopole MIMO antenna with pattern diversity and wide beamwidth coverage in elevation plane for C-band applications
task: Wideband MIMO antenna design with high isolation and pattern diversity for C-band
key_results: 10-dB bandwidth 4–8 GHz, isolation >23.3 dB, ECC <0.0017, passband gain 6.5–9.4 dBi, HPBW >132°
comments: The approach of merging three higher-order monopole resonances via offset feeding is elegant; rotationally symmetric placement efficiently decouples four antenna elements.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Merging three higher-order resonances via offset-feed and patch-width optimization yields wideband coverage
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 4–8 GHz 10-dB bandwidth achieved

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rotationally symmetric placement and shorting stubs provide high inter-element isolation without degrading resonances
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; >23.3 dB isolation maintained across passband

title: Diameter-dependent nanojoint formation and grain refinement in femtosecond laser nanojoining of AgNWs
task: Nanojoint formation and grain refinement in femtosecond laser-welded silver nanowires
key_results: 60 nm AgNWs achieve 544% relative joint cross-sectional area; grain refinement to 4.42 nm (vs. 15.69–26.27 nm in non-bonded regions)
comments: The diameter-dependent effect is striking and well-explained by FDTD-computed electric field concentration, though mechanism relies on localized heating/melting.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Smaller nanowire diameters enable stronger nanojoint formation due to enhanced electric field confinement
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 60 nm wires show dramatically larger joint area than 200–300 nm wires

hypotheses.hypothesis: Regions of higher electric field intensity exhibit refined polycrystalline grains
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; nanojoint interface grains ~4.42 nm vs. ~15–26 nm elsewhere

title: Uniaxial structural flexibility of an anisotropic Br adlayer structure on Au(100) electrodes revealed by video-rate STM
task: Characterization of structural flexibility in anisotropic Br adlayer on Au(100) via video-rate STM
key_results: Observed uniaxial dynamic distortions along [010] via antiphase shifting of Br rows; DFT confirms low diffusion barriers for fractional vacancies
comments: Video-rate STM elegantly captures sub-second timescale dynamics of a dense coadsorbate phase; the link between 1D vacancy diffusion and macroscopic structural flexibility is well-supported.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structural anisotropy of the c(√2×2√2)R45° Br adlayer permits dynamic uniaxial distortions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; strong [010] antiphase shifting observed in real time

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rapid 1D diffusion of fractional vacancies explains structural flexibility
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by DFT showing low diffusion barriers for vacancy motion
